steps.name: Clear confirmation skips
steps.do: From the project root, run `npm run clear:itinerary-config`, then reload **Itinerary**.
steps.expect: Command reports no **Don't show this again** skips (or clears any that were on). Short Visit / Early Admission confirmations are no longer skipped.

steps.name: Valid times
steps.do: Set a sensible arrival before departure.

steps.name: Short visit
steps.do: With both arrival and departure set, change them to a visit shorter than **2 hours** (e.g. arrival **10:00 AM**, departure **11:00 AM**).

steps.name: Longer visit
steps.do: Change arrival and departure so the visit is at least **2 hours** (e.g. arrival **10:00 AM**, departure **2:00 PM**).
steps.expect: Times are kept. **Short Visit?** does not appear (or is already dismissed).

steps.name: Cancel early admission
steps.expect: Early Admission not applied (or reverts) — note.

steps.name: Confirm early admission
steps.do: Enable again and confirm membership/sensory requirements.

steps.name: Times after EA
steps.do: Check arrival bounds after Early Admission.
steps.expect: Times adjust or flag as designed.

steps.name: Schedule still coherent
steps.do: View Day Planner pills if any.
